primary_question: Can a dynamic, individualized, event-aware representation of prior athlete performance improve one-step-ahead prediction while abstaining when development evidence is insufficient?
target: Next individual running performance in seconds, modeled in log-time space.
claim_boundary: Preliminary retrospective validation of the longitudinal performance-state mechanism only. NRCD does not validate ATHENA's daily sleep, soreness, stress, hydration, medical, injury-prevention, or return-to-play features.

dataset.name: National Running Club Database (NRCD) anonymized public dataset
dataset.attribution: National Running Club Database public dataset; see bundled data/README.md and upstream DATASHEET.md for creators, collection, ethics, and limitations.
dataset.known_limitation: Pre-August-2023 metadata is sparser, indoor weather is generally unavailable, and 2026 coverage ends in May.

protocol.strategy: rolling-origin retrospective validation with explicit calibration and trust-region abstention
protocol.leakage_rule: Every sample's features use only that athlete/event's results before the target race. Model fitting precedes calibration year; calibration precedes evaluation year.
protocol.development_disclosure: Earlier exploratory model versions were inspected during development; results are therefore presented as preliminary retrospective validation, not a pristine prospective clinical or competition-blind test.

model_hierarchy.notes: Static event+gender median from training years.
Strong direct nonlinear comparator using the same available history/context; retained even though it underperforms.
Nonlinear residual correction only inside calibrated trust region; λ=0.3.

active_trust_region.interpretation: Conditional diagnostic for cases where the calibration-derived trust region activates; it is not a separately tuned test subset.

cluster_bootstrap_vs_personalized.interpretation: Athlete-cluster bootstrap resamples athletes rather than treating repeated race records as independent.

cluster_bootstrap_vs_population.interpretation: Athlete-cluster bootstrap resamples athletes rather than treating repeated race records as independent.

athlete_randomization_vs_personalized.interpretation: Paired athlete-level sign-flip diagnostic. Small p-values indicate the observed direction is difficult to reproduce by random sign assignment under the exchangeability assumption; this does not make the retrospective study prospective or causal.

feature_group_permutation_importance.interpretation: Calibration-set grouped permutation diagnostic; positive means performance worsened when the group was permuted.

calibration_alternatives.reason_not_selected: On the already-observed retrospective evaluation it slightly reduced empirical coverage while widening the median interval; retained as a negative diagnostic rather than a post-hoc replacement.

failure_categories.category: Large error outside dynamic trust region

forward_shift_audit.interpretation: The 2024-calibrated trust region rarely activates in the partial 2026 event mix; ATHENA mostly abstains to the personalized baseline rather than extrapolating aggressively.

data_dictionary.athlete_id: Upstream anonymized athlete identifier; used only for grouping/history and cluster bootstrap.
data_dictionary.target_seconds: Archived next performance time in seconds; prediction target.
data_dictionary.last_time/recent3/ewma/mean/median/best: Lagged athlete-event performance summaries computed strictly before the target.
data_dictionary.prior_count: Number of earlier results for the same athlete and event.
data_dictionary.days_since: Days since the prior same-event result.
data_dictionary.trend_recent: Difference between recent lag summaries; computed from prior results only.
data_dictionary.temperature/humidity/dew_point/wind_spee: Meet/course context when upstream metadata is available.

cleaning_log: Deduplicate upstream joined export by result_id.
Parse timed individual running/hurdle/steeple events only; exclude relays and field events for this target.
Remove only grossly impossible parsed durations (<5 s or >8 h).
Construct all lag/history features using results strictly before each target.
Do not post-hoc remove large held-out discontinuities; report them as difficult-case diagnostics.

failure_iteration.v0_observation: An initial absolute-time nonlinear model underperformed the simple personalized baseline, demonstrating that complexity alone did not help.
failure_iteration.diagnosis: Absolute prediction over-corrected stable athlete/event histories and treated context as universally useful.
failure_iteration.change: Reformulated ATHENA as a residual correction around a personalized baseline, tuned shrinkage only on a calibration year, and added an event+freshness trust region that abstains to the baseline outside supported conditions.
failure_iteration.lesson: ATHENA should earn complexity locally and preserve a strong simple baseline when evidence for correction is weak. A direct nonlinear HGB comparator and event-conditional interval calibration were also retained as negative diagnostics when they failed to improve the retrospective evaluation.
